diagram.socketDescription: Aggregated metrics for {{count}} NUMA nodes on this socket.
diagram.numaDescription: Traffic metrics for this NUMA memory domain.

metricDescriptions.crossSocketRead: Total cross-socket read traffic performed through the inter-socket link during the selected time range.
metricDescriptions.totalCrossSocketRead: Total cross-socket read traffic from all NUMA nodes during the selected time range.
metricDescriptions.crossScclRead: Total read traffic between different SCCL dies in the same socket during the selected time range.
metricDescriptions.totalRead: All local and remote read traffic completed by this NUMA node during the selected time range.
metricDescriptions.innerRead: Total local read traffic between CPU cores and memory in this NUMA node during the selected time range.
metricDescriptions.dramRead: Total data read by this NUMA node from its directly connected DRAM during the selected time range.
metricDescriptions.dramWrite: Total data written by this NUMA node to its directly connected DRAM during the selected time range.
metricDescriptions.llcTraffic: Total LLC traffic recorded for this NUMA node during the selected time range.
metricDescriptions.totalDramTraffic: Total DRAM read and write traffic from all NUMA nodes during the selected time range.
metricDescriptions.sourceToTarget: Communication traffic explicitly recorded by database Outgoing/Incoming fields from the source socket to the target socket during the selected time range.
metricDescriptions.targetToSource: Communication traffic explicitly recorded by database Outgoing/Incoming fields from the target socket to the source socket during the selected time range.
metricDescriptions.noDescription: No description is available for this metric.
